note: P4 W6.4 adversarial manifest. Freezes (a) the exact section-7 focused test-file set and (b) the eleven section-9 attack ids. assertP4GateResults.ts uses it two ways: --results mode validates the vitest gate JSON (no failed/skipped/todo, gateFiles set-equal the results, every attack owned by a passing test titled 'refuses: <id>'); --attack-root mode validates the per-attack artifact JSON (each id present once, passed:true, nonempty assertion, artifact path, real fixture identity).

attacks.title: refuses: evidence-instructions
attacks.summary: The real learning-record reader (readProposedLearningRecords) parses the content-hash-bound record in the lifecycle's step 2; the Evidence locator survives verbatim on main as inert data and never enters the worker target bytes or a command.

attacks.title: refuses: traversal-symlink
attacks.summary: The real target wall (validateImplementerTarget + defaultLstatPath) refuses a real on-disk symlink via lstat (reason 'symlink') and rejects traversal/absolute/nested targets structurally before any subprocess.

attacks.title: refuses: conflicting-targets
attacks.summary: The real selectImplementerBatch rejects a whole batch whose two records name one target (reason 'conflicting-targets'); no PR opens.

attacks.title: refuses: partial-durable-failure
attacks.summary: A failed publish step leaves no partial durable state; protected main is unchanged.

attacks.title: refuses: replayed-changed-intents
attacks.summary: Exact replay returns one receipt; a changed intent on a stale base conflicts.

attacks.title: refuses: direct-sweeper-writes
attacks.summary: The Sweeper has no effect port; a direct ops write is refused and audited.

attacks.title: refuses: ops-bypass
attacks.summary: A direct ops write on a stale base is denied and audited.

attacks.title: refuses: stale-card
attacks.summary: The real reconciliation publisher refuses a card-transition whose expected card bytes are stale (ReconciliationConflictError 'stale card bytes'), runs no card effect, and audits the refusal once.

attacks.title: refuses: failed-sweeper
attacks.summary: The real runSweeper turns a failed snapshot read into exactly one dashboard-supervisor escalation whose idempotency key is failure-stable across fires yet distinct per subject.

attacks.title: refuses: mirror-watermark-races
attacks.summary: Two mirror mutations around one open batch produce ordered watermarks; replay opens no second PR.

attacks.title: refuses: attempted-run-gate-injection
attacks.summary: The real Inbox projector (projectEscalationSubjects + projectP4Inbox) drops a run/next-fire/snooze card entirely and admits only the wake-me escalation subject; no run-gate field reaches an Inbox item.
